name: FrimTec GmbH
desc: FrimTec IMS reveals what remains hidden. With intelligent monitoring solutions, we provide reliable and long-term protection for buildings, cultural assets, and sensitive spaces. Our wireless sensor systems collect relevant environmental and condition data—from temperature, humidity, light, and air quality to material moisture and crack movements. This allows changes to be detected early on, before they result in damage. Thanks to a long wireless range, even sprawling museums, castles, and historic buildings can be reliably monitored across multiple floors. Sensors in display cases or hard-to-reach areas can also be easily integrated. FrimTec IMS combines modern sensor technology with clear, long-term data analysis, creating a reliable foundation for the sustainable preservation of valuable buildings and cultural heritage. Detect earlier. Preserve better.

name: Hessler Kalkwerke GmbH
desc: Hessler Kalk Tradition. Responsibility. Longevity. Since 1881, Hessler Kalkwerke has been synonymous with natural lime building materials manufactured in-house. As a fourth-generation family business, we combine traditional craftsmanship with the demands of modern architecture. At the heart of our work is natural hydraulic lime from our own quarry. We use it to develop durable, vapour-permeable and capillary-active plasters and renders that regulate moisture and help create healthy indoor environments. For us, material honesty means pared-back formulations using carefully selected raw materials – without preservatives or synthetic binders, and without gypsum or cement in our pure natural lime systems. We openly disclose the origins and ingredients of our products and have them independently tested. Our responsibility extends from the careful use of raw materials and in-house production to the ecological restoration of our sites. At the same time, we develop building materials that protect and preserve buildings for the long term. Personal advice is an integral part of our work. Together with architects and planners, tradespeople and building owners, we create solutions that excel in technical performance, design and craftsmanship. Made from Lime. For Generations.

name: Lehm-Laden GmbH & Co. KG
desc: Old houses deserve building materials that suit them. Preserving historic buildings means understanding their materials and construction methods. Lehm-Laden combines craftsmanship with advice on sustainable building practices and offers a wide range of products for working on existing structures: from clay and lime plasters to clay bricks and natural insulation materials, as well as lime and linseed oil paints. We support craft businesses, planners, and property owners in selecting suitable building materials and clarifying questions regarding installation and application. Whether it’s infilling half-timbered walls, interior insulation, or the design of historic surfaces—the starting point is the existing building structure and what the building needs. We deliver the appropriate materials throughout Europe. Meet us at denkmal 2026 in Leipzig. Bring your questions and your next project—we look forward to a professional exchange.

desc: SCHOTT is a leading international technology group specializing in specialty glass and glass-ceramics, with more than 140 years of expertise in materials and applications. Manufactured using the traditional Fourcault process, it faithfully reproduces the characteristic surface structures of past centuries while meeting today’s requirements for safety, energy efficiency and comfort. From GOETHEGLAS to RESTOVER® and TIKANA® our portfolio enables authentic restoration across different eras. With a wide range of processing options – including laminated, insulating and functional glazing with UV, thermal or acoustic performance – SCHOTT supports architects and restoration specialists in preserving cultural heritage while upgrading it for modern use.

name: Udi Dämmsysteme GmbH
desc: UdiDämmsysteme is an innovative company with over 30 years experience as a provider and manufacturer of insulation systems made from natural wood fibre. You won’t be able to see our products once they’re installed – but you’ll certainly feel them. That’s because, alongside technical benefits such as high insulation performance, they also offer a range of advantages for indoor climate control. One of the most important is that wood fibres naturally regulate humidity. This means that mould – one of the biggest housing problems of our time – doesn’t stand a chance. Over 80,000 completed construction projects across Europe bear witness to the high quality of our materials and workmanship. Whether you wish to insulate an older house or a new build, whether it’s the external or internal walls, a flat in a block of flats or just individual rooms – the range of UdiDämm systems available is as diverse as the tasks themselves.
